text: {"action":"NO_TRADE","sizePct":0,"stopPct":0,"conviction":0.3,"rationale":"The packet is purely technical and shows a weak but confirmed downtrend (close -1.1% vs SMA20, SMA20<SMA50, momentum -1.0%/20d and -1.1%/5d, bias bearish) heading into a BINARY macro catalyst with zero directional information. Risk/reward is unattractive in both directions: a trend-aligned short targets only ~1 ATR (~-1.6% to ~663.8) yet needs a ~3.1% stop above SMA20 (2*ATR to 695.15) to survive catalyst-driven volatility expansion — negative expectancy.
